queries: WITH per_sex AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ana) OVER (), 0) AS ana_ratio FROM per_sex

assumptions.assumption: Patients with missing sex are excluded because they cannot be assigned to a sex group.

alternatives.interpretation: Include patients with missing sex as a NULL sex group.

assumptions.assumption: Patients with missing sex are excluded because their examinations cannot be assigned to a known sex group. AVG ignores missing measurement values.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat missing sex as its own group and include its ANA average in the mean of per-sex averages.
alternatives.sql: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, AVG(e.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg, AVG(e.ANA) AS avg_ana FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX) SELECT sex, avg_acl_igg, avg_ana, avg_ana / NULLIF(AVG(avg_ana) OVER (), 0) AS ana_ratio FROM sex_averages ORDER BY sex
